title: Deputy Chairman and Deputy Speaker Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Deputy Chairman and Deputy Speaker Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

DEPUTY CHAIRMAN AND DEPUTY SPEAKER (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
DEPUTY CHAIRMAN
AND DEPUTY SPEAKER (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
2002
ORDINANCE XLI OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Deputy Chairman and Deputy Speaker (Salaries, Allowances
and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part-I, 16th August, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated
16-8-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Deputy Chairman and
Deputy Speaker (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Ordinance,
2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

2002
ORDINANCE XLI OF 2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Deputy Chairman and Deputy Speaker (Salaries, Allowances
and Privileges) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part-I, 16th August, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002-Pub. dated
16-8-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
2. Amendment of section 3, Act
LXXXIII of 1975.---In the Deputy Chairman and Deputy Speaker Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (LXXXIII of 1975), in section 3, for the
words "eighteen thousand rupees" the words "thirty-seven
thousand rupees" shall be substituted.
